messages:
maria: Heads up — CI perf unit failed on PR #10102 after merge. microbench throughput down ~6% on batcher->kernel path. Failing test: runtime/micro/batcher_latency. Appears correlated with kernel-selector + kv-heuristics change. cc @chris @jin

chris: on it. link to CI output?

maria: https://ci.redwood/12345/artifacts/perf-summary.txt

maria: perf-summary excerpt:
```
bench: batcher_lat_p99
baseline: 12.4 ms
current: 13.1 ms  (+5.6%)
kernel_selector: v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0
kv_prefetch: enabled -> adaptive
```

perf-bot: regression detected: batcher_lat_p99 exceeded threshold ( +5.6% ). auto-annotated: possible offender files: runtime/autoselect/*.rs, runtime/cache/*.rs

jin: I saw the kv prefetch flip in the PR — adaptive prefetch is more aggressive for seqlen=1 workloads; could be increasing contention on the scheduler.

aaron: can someone run the same microbench locally with --profile=hotspots? want CPU/GPU kernel mix and scheduling timeline.

chris: ran locally on devbox, reproduces ~+5% p99. Attached local flame snippet (trimmed):
```
0.00-0.50s: batcher wait +12ms
0.50-0.80s: kernel launch overhead +4ms
kv cache lookup: +1ms
```

chris: initial hunch: kernel-autoselect v2.4 picks a slightly different kernel for short sequences which increases launch overhead under high fanout. also batcher wait increased — maybe due to adaptive prefetch causing queue thrash.

maria: bisect requested. last good commit on main: 6a1f9e3, first bad: 6b2f2aa (merge of PR #10098). PR touches both autoselect and kv heuristics.

jin: I'll start a bisect tomorrow. quick mitigation: can we gate adaptive prefetch behind feature flag so Dedicated/Hosted keep stable path? cc @eng-ci

eng-ci: we can flip feature flag for CI and Hosted but not for current Dedicated rollout until revert/patch lands. To be safe, blocking this PR from release channels until bisect completes. :no_entry:

chris: workaround we tested: set `RUNTIME_KERNEL_HINT=prioritized` on the runtime worker, drops p99 back to 12.5ms locally. command:
```
export RUNTIME_KERNEL_HINT=prioritized
./scripts/run_microbench --bench batcher_lat_p99
```

maria: good. I'll add the flag to the rollout block /ticket and note the temporary override. :memo:

perf-bot: added perf regression ticket PERF-4887 and linked CI artifacts.

aaron: if bisect shows autoselect is root cause we should revert that commit and re-land kv heuristics separately. if kv prefetched too aggressively we can tune thresholds instead of full revert.

jin: starting bisect now — will post results in this thread. assigning myself and @chris to the investigation. PR remains blocked for rollout. :eyes:

maria: thanks team. keep updates short, post bisect commit hash when found.
